# EKG Event

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

Recording an EKG reading from Apple Watch EKG app or Kardia 6-lead EKG device.

**Also known as:** ECG Event

## Scope note

Narrower than HealthEvent; a single EKG reading or recording, alongside GlucoseEvent, InsulinEvent, and BloodPressureEvent.

## Broader

- [HealthEvent](../HealthEvent/) — generic (ISO 25964)
